title: blechnum durum
intro: Blechnum durum, commonly known as the golden-veined chain fern, is a species of fern belonging to the Blechnaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving inflammation and soothing respiratory issues, making it beneficial for individuals with conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Blechnum durum are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, helping to alleviate congestion and ease breathing. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
